title: Preview an authorized dynamic purchase-order report
description: User scene: a purchasing user selects finite purchase-order fields and supplier/date/status/currency filters to preview a bounded report. Require the current user's existing purchase-order menu permission; reuse existing purchase-order visibility rather than introducing a broader role or data-scope policy. Supplier or order references remain raw persisted evidence, not payable balance or settlement. Invalid fields/filters and missing permission fail closed before querying; no arbitrary SQL. Existing HTTP operation audit records read-only requests. Development only: no Domain or schema changes, migration, production SQL, real database execution, writes, secret/.env change or deployment. Verify unit tests and safe build/test.
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated catalog exposes only finite persisted purchase-order fields; preview rejects unknown columns, malformed date/supplier/status/currency filters and page size above 100 before data reads.

Preview checks the current user's existing purchase-order menu, filters nondeleted purchase orders by supplier/date/status/currency, and returns stable bounded paging with selected columns and no writes.
Tests cover permitted/denied users, filters, selected field order, 100-row cap, soft deletion, invalid input and no writes; document permission and financial-evidence limits.
